hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: A special substring is composed of identical repeated characters.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Group consecutive identical characters into runs. For each character, keep track of all run lengths.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: For a given run length L, it contains (L - len + 1) substrings of length len. Find the maximum length len that appears at least three times across all runs of the same character.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maximumLength(self, s: str) -> int:
        from collections import defaultdict
        runs = defaultdict(list)
        n = len(s)
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            j = i
            while j < n and s[j] == s[i]:
                j += 1
            runs[s[i]].append(j - i)
            i = j
        ans = -1
        for ch, lens in runs.items():
            lens.sort(reverse=True)
            l1 = lens[0]
            l2 = lens[1] if len(lens) > 1 else 0
            l3 = lens[2] if len(lens) > 2 else 0
            cand = max(l1 - 2, min(l1 - 1, l2), l3)
            if cand > 0:
                ans = max(ans, cand)
        return ans
```

variables: n: size of input array or string
